description: RICE / ICE / WSJF Prioritization — Offline backlog prioritization. Pass items= as name:numbers separated by | or newlines and method=rice (reach,impact,confidence %,effort -> R x I x C / E), ice (impact,confidence,ease -> product) or wsjf (business value,time criticality,risk reduction,job size -> cost of delay / size). Returns ranked items with score, formula, relative %, NOW/NEXT/LATER tier, ties, whether the top item is a clear winner, input-scale warnings and skipped lines. Up to 200 items. method defaults to rice. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_prioritize
